messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming.decode.p99 exceeded threshold in us-west-2 (service: streaming-api). Current p99 = 1.9s (SLO: 1.0s). Triggered alert group: streaming-decode-tail · severity: P1 · #events=324 in 5m
Ryan (oncall): picking this up. seeing the incident page now. which deploy rolled today?
Sandeep (eng-runtime): TRT8/flashattn kernel variant rolled to canary earlier at 09:12 PT, promoted to 60% at 09:40. rolling canary notes said "minor latency wins".
Maya (sre): live dashboards show a sharp tail increase coincident with 09:40 promotion. p95 up from 220ms to 480ms, p99 from 600ms to 1.9s.
Ryan (oncall): thanks. are only streaming endpoints affected or decode/generation too?
Ben (eng): looks like streaming (kv-cache + tail) paths primarily. non-streaming batch endpoints p99 stable. logs show repeated stalls in decode kernel / kernel preemption around the same requests.
Julie (prod): Leah flagged 3 enterprise customers seeing timeouts for streaming sessions; support ticket numbers: INC-4392, INC-4394. customers reporting partial failures and long stalls.
Leah (customer-success): all three customers are on our hosted API using default model variants (gpt-open-32k). They reported timeouts and degraded UX in chat integrations.
Emily (support): submitted initial customer-impact note to status page: "Partial degradation for streaming chat — retries recommended."
Sandeep (eng-runtime): digging into kernel logs. grep shows a repeating stack with flash_attn_forward in the decode path and occasional cudaSync errors. suspect interaction between new TRT kernels + flash attention tiled path and long sequences.
Maya (sre): can you dump p99 by host? I want heatmap.
Sandeep (eng-runtime): pasted host-level p99 snippet:
```
us-west-2-host-023: p99=2.1s (10% reqs stalled)
us-west-2-host-046: p99=2.4s (12% reqs stalled)
us-west-2-host-102: p99=1.8s (8% reqs stalled)
```
Ryan (oncall): consistent with region-local compile path regression. Any recent compiler flag flips?
Ben (eng): yes — we enabled `-O3 -funsafe-math-optimizations` for the TRT8 build and turned on `flash_attn_tile=enabled` in the runtime config earlier this week. Both were part of the performance bundle.
Sandeep (eng-runtime): stack traces show decode threads stuck on `nv::cuda::streamSynchronize` when a particular attn kernel path runs on long sequences. Also seeing elevated page-fault counts on the kernel allocator (shadow paging evictions).
Maya (sre): paging evictions + sync stalls = bad tail latency combo. We should isolate: rollback kernel variant OR toggle flash_attn_tile remotely if runtime supports flag.
Ryan (oncall): can we flip the runtime flag first? less risky than full rollback.
Sandeep (eng-runtime): runtime supports dynamic flags via config service. I'll push `flash_attn_tile=disabled` to 100% for us-west-2. Doing: `curl -XPOST https://config.internal/flags -d '{"flash_attn_tile":false,"env":"us-west-2"}'`
deploy-bot: flag-update: flash_attn_tile set to false in us-west-2 by Sandeep at 09:58 PT.
Maya (sre): monitoring...
Maya (sre): 5m check: p95 dropped to 340ms, p99 to 1.1s. improvement but still above SLO.
Ben (eng): promising. the pagefault metric also decreased ~30%. but some hosts still at p99>1.2s. could be residual eviction/backpressure.
Ryan (oncall): try shifting a portion of streaming traffic to the legacy kernel variant (v2.3) as a fallback while we investigate root cause. Can we do gradual routing?
Sandeep (eng-runtime): yes, we have routing by kernel tag. Creating rollout to move 30% traffic to `kernel-v2.3-legacy` for streaming endpoints in us-west-2: `robin rollout kernel-v2.3-legacy --service=streaming-api --region=us-west-2 --percent=30 --reason='mitigate p99 stalls'`
deploy-bot: rollout started: kernel-v2.3-legacy -> streaming-api us-west-2 (30%) by Sandeep.
Maya (sre): 10m after routing: p95 = 260ms, p99 = 760ms. customer incidents reporting improved. Leah: can you confirm with customers?
Leah (customer-success): confirmed — two of three reported measurable improvement within 8 minutes; one customer still sees intermittent stalls but it's much rarer. They've paused one integration job as a precaution.
Julie (prod): what's the plan: revert the TRT8 promotion entirely or keep disabled flag and continue routing? We need decide containment vs rollback.
Ben (eng): short term: keep the runtime flag off and continue the fallback routing while we run a root-cause test on a staging fleet replicating long-seq workload. We should not re-enable `-funsafe-math-optimizations` in the build until we understand numeric/regression surface.
Sandeep (eng-runtime): agreed. I'll queue a controlled canary test with long-seq synthetic traces, toggling flash_attn_tile on-off and measuring pagefault + cuda-sync latency.
Ryan (oncall): I'll file incident page and set severity to sev2->sev1 depending on customer impact. Also starting a handoff note: current mitigation = runtime flag off + 30% traffic to kernel-v2.3-legacy. Next oncall at 13:00 PT will take over live watch.
Maya (sre): assign Ben/Sandeep to root-cause; Leah to coordinate customer comms; Julie to own service-level decision for rollback if metrics don't improve.
Emily (support): updating tickets and status page: "Investigating performance regression affecting streaming tails. Mitigations in progress: routing to legacy kernel and disabling flash tiled attn."
Ryan (oncall): leaving for handoff in 45m. quick checklist for next oncall: 1) watch p95/p99 trend for 30m windows 2) confirm no new customer timeouts 3) be ready to flip routing to 0/100 if needed 4) ensure canary tests continue.
Sandeep (eng-runtime): recording logs and dumps for postmortem. saving `kdump` and `cuda-proc` traces from impacted hosts to s3://inc-5123456789/artifacts/ for later.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-5123456789 · status: mitigating · owner: Sandeep (eng-runtime) · severity: P1 -> mitigated->monitoring.
Ryan (oncall): handing off to next oncall (Ben @13:00 PT). Ben — I'll DM the runbook and artifacts.
Ben (eng): got it. I'll be online at 13:00 PT and follow the checklist. will also coordinate with infra to prepare rollback playbook if needed.
Leah (customer-success): sending follow-up to affected customers: short note + ETA for next update in 60 minutes.
Julie (prod): log action items: 1) root cause RCA (Ben/Sandeep) 2) decide on rollback vs keep flag off (Product + Eng) 3) postmortem + communication (Ops) 4) test harness for long-seq performance validation (SRE).
Ryan (oncall): closing thread for now — monitoring. escalate if p99 > 1.5s persists or more customers report issues.
